china_race_dynamics.text: An alarming and emerging threat made more apparent this year comes from the cyber domain. Cyberattacks launched from increasingly aggressive adversaries like China, North Korea, Iran and Russia will be countered by critical investments in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.

deepseek.reason: The speaker names China as a cyber adversary and supports AI/cybersecurity investments, but does not address AI competition with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: China and AI are mentioned, but the focus is cyber threat response rather than AI race priority.

astra.reason: The speaker describes AI investments countering cyberattacks from China and other adversaries without endorsing an AI race with China.
astra.confidence_reason: China and AI are explicitly connected, but the statement concerns cybersecurity rather than competitive AI leadership.
